output.review_comment: The PR contains a logical error in the cap/minimum ordering logic that contradicts its own explanation. The new code makes the minimum win when it's higher than the cap, not the cap always winning. Please clarify: (1) What does the actual docstring say about cap vs minimum precedence? (2) Why were the min/max operations reordered in this specific way? (3) Include test case examples that verify the intended behavior, especially edge cases where cap and minimum might conflict. The other two changes (period counting and rounding) appear sound, but this ordering change needs clarification before approval.
